nodes.title: Sun_Direction Lora INSTRUCTIONS:
widgets_values:
## Sun_Direction Lora

**This lora mainly works for exteriors.
Whatever image is not an exterior, I can't assure it will work correctly as it hasn't been trained with any interior images.**

Download the Sun_Direction lora from here:

- [Sun_direction_LoRA_Flux_2_Klein_9b_v1.safetensors](https://huggingface.co/eric-venti-seeds/Sun-Direction-Lora-Flux2Klein9B/tree/main)


Download the Sphere Light Render Node from here:

- [Sphere-Light-Render-ComfyUI Node](https://github.com/eric-venti-seeds/Sphere-Light-Render-ComfyUI)

**The Lora trigger sentence is:**



>match the sun direction from the reference






Feel free to add any other words needed after the trigeer sentence like: "add a clear blue sky" or "keep the cloudy sky"

It works way way better if the image doesn't have a clear light direction, like an overcast day.

If the image you want to add or change the sun direction is already overcast or without a clear light direction you can deactivate the top part.

At the moment the top part generates an overcast image to be ready to apply the sun in second bottom block.

There's a Blender file in Hugginface and Github to generate the ball images in case you need to do a timelapse.

If you wanna do a timelapse with different balls with different light directions, generate them with a fixed seed to avoid some flickering between the images.

Hope you like it! 

Eric Venti.
